<div class="seven-decades-section">
  <!-- MAIN HERO HEADING -->
  <div class="seven-decades-header">
    <div class="hero-eyebrow">An Empirical Motoring Investigation &bull; 1970 &mdash; 2024</div>
    <h1 class="timeline-headline" style="font-size: clamp(2.4rem, 5.5vw, 4.4rem); letter-spacing: -0.02em; text-transform: uppercase;">Where did car character go?</h1>
    <p class="timeline-subtitle" style="max-width: 680px; margin: 1rem auto 0; font-size: 1.15rem; color: var(--text-muted); line-height: 1.6;">

    </p>

  <div style="max-width: 780px; margin: 0 auto 3rem; text-align: center; padding: 0 1rem;">

      When drivers argue that modern cars lack personality, they usually point to three complaints:
    </p>
    <div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(220px, 1fr)); gap: 1rem; margin-bottom: 1.75rem;">

        <span style="display:block; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--color-gold); margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">CLAIM 01</span>
        <strong style="color: var(--text-ink); font-size: 1rem;">&ldquo;They are all grey.&rdquo;</strong>
        <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0.4rem 0 0;">Did automotive paint palettes actually shrink?</p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: var(--bg-cream); border: 1px solid var(--border-rule); padding: 1.25rem 1rem; border-radius: 2px;">
        <span style="display:block; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--color-gold); margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">CLAIM 02</span>
        <strong style="color: var(--text-ink); font-size: 1rem;">&ldquo;They all look the same.&rdquo;</strong>
        <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0.4rem 0 0;">Did vehicle body shapes and silhouettes converge?</p>
      </div>
      <div style="background: var(--bg-cream); border: 1px solid var(--border-rule); padding: 1.25rem 1rem; border-radius: 2px;">
        <span style="display:block; font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; color: var(--color-gold); margin-bottom: 0.35rem;">CLAIM 03</span>
        <strong style="color: var(--text-ink); font-size: 1rem;">&ldquo;They sound like appliances.&rdquo;</strong>
        <p style="font-size: 0.85rem; color: var(--text-muted); margin: 0.4rem 0 0;">What happened to mechanical variety and acoustics?</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    <p style="font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--text-muted); font-style: italic;">
      A feeling isn't data. We gathered 55 years of paint popularity, 16,469 classified body dimensions, and 29,880 powertrain records to measure what changed.
    </p>
